moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off Tonight
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially kicks off tonight with Arsenal hosting newly-promoted Coventry City at 9 PM.

angles.name: Match Build-up
angles.copy: It all starts tonight! Arsenal vs Coventry City kicks off the new Premier League season at 9 PM. Who are you backing for the first goal of 26/27?

angles.name: Fantasy Football
angles.copy: Premier League is BACK! Don't forget to get your Fantasy Football teams locked in before tonight's Arsenal vs Coventry opener. Are your captains ready?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Approaching
moments.blurb: Reading & Leeds Festivals, two of the UK's biggest music events, are set to take place across the August Bank Holiday weekend, from August 27-30, with headliners including Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C., Chase & Status Live, and Raye.

angles.name: Excitement Build-up
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds is just days away! Who's packing their wellies and heading to one of the UK's biggest festivals this Bank Holiday weekend?

angles.name: Headliner Spotlight
angles.copy: From Charli XCX to Florence + The Machine, Dave to Fontaines D.C., the Reading & Leeds lineup is stacked! Which headliner are you most hyped to see?

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The late August Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is just around the corner, falling on Monday, August 31st, marking a long weekend for many.

angles.name: Planning Ahead
angles.copy: Long weekend incoming! The August Bank Holiday is Monday 31st. What are your plans for the extra day off? Making the most of the last of summer?

angles.name: Summer Send-off
angles.copy: The final Bank Holiday of summer is almost here! How are you sending off the season this long weekend?

moments.title: Latest UK Singles Chart Revealed
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart for August 13-19 saw Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold the #1 spot with 'Rein Me In', with Shakira & Burna Boy at #2 and a new entry from Madonna & Kylie Minogue at #8.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: The latest Official Singles Chart is in! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still holding strong at #1. What's been your favourite new track this week?

angles.name: New Entry Buzz
angles.copy: Madonna and Kylie Minogue joining forces for 'Love Sensation' and landing at #8 on the chart! Is this the collab of the summer?

moments.title: Beautiful Days Festival in Devon
moments.blurb: The Beautiful Days Festival, a family-friendly event, is taking place this weekend, August 21-23, at Escot Park in Ottery Saint Mary, Devon.

angles.name: Devon Festival Fun
angles.copy: Beautiful Days Festival is on this weekend in Ottery Saint Mary! Who's heading to Escot Park for three days of music and good vibes?

angles.name: Local Weekend Plans
angles.copy: If you're in Devon this weekend, Beautiful Days is kicking off! What's your favourite thing about local festivals?

moments.title: Welsh Government's 'Future of Wales' Consultation
moments.blurb: The Welsh Government has launched a national conversation on how Wales should develop towards 2050, with a public consultation now open until November 20.

angles.name: Shape Wales 2050
angles.copy: How do you see Wales in 2050? The Welsh Government wants YOUR views on housing, jobs, transport and more, with a consultation open now!

angles.name: Local Impact
angles.copy: This is a chance to shape Wales for decades to come. What changes would you like to see in your local community by 2050?

moments.title: Ongoing Wildfires in South Wales
moments.blurb: Emergency services and military personnel continue to battle a large, deep-seated wildfire on the hillside above Blaenavon, with other fires also affecting the South Wales valleys.

angles.name: Community Support
angles.copy: Our thoughts are with the firefighters and military battling the ongoing wildfires in South Wales, particularly around Blaenavon. Stay safe everyone.

angles.name: Local Fire Update
angles.copy: The fight against the South Wales wildfires continues. Huge thanks to all involved – please stay vigilant and follow advice from emergency services.

moments.title: Exeter Museum Boiler Crisis
moments.blurb: Exeter City Council is set to hold an extraordinary meeting next week, August 25, to discuss a £260,000 bailout for boiler repairs at the Royal Albert Memorial Museum (RAMM), with fears of potential closure.

angles.name: Save RAMM
angles.copy: Exeter's Royal Albert Memorial Museum is facing a £260k boiler crisis next week. What are your favourite memories of RAMM? Let's keep our cultural gems open!

angles.name: Council Meeting
angles.copy: Major talks happening at Exeter City Council next week regarding RAMM's future. This is a big one for our city's heritage. What do you think should happen?

moments.title: Happy 61st Birthday, Shania Twain

angles.name: Vocal Powerhouse
